name: Floating Bakery Above a Sea of Clouds
description: A small floating bakery with hanging bread baskets and glowing windows drifts above an endless cloud sea at sunset.
prompt: A single fantasy image of a small floating bakery suspended above an endless sea of clouds at sunset. Wooden balconies, hanging bread baskets, warm glowing windows, loaves and pastries on display, steam rising, golden-pink sky, soft pastel colors, whimsical, detailed, no text, no logos, no watermark.
caption: The best bakery might be just above the clouds.
